seoTitle: The Walking Dead Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take The Walking Dead test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Rick, Daryl, Michonne, Carol, Glenn, Maggie, Negan or Eugene — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the one who'd do anything to protect your people, the quiet one who just gets it done, or the one who talks your way out of everything? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle trust, pressure and the people you love, and find out which Walking Dead survivor you are.

characters.name: Rick Grimes
characters.title: The Protector
characters.summary: You'd do anything for your family — and people follow you, even when you're not sure where you're going.
description: Like Rick, you're a natural leader who never asked for the job. He was a sheriff's deputy who woke up from a coma to find the world had ended — and within weeks, everyone was looking to him.
You believe in doing the right thing, and you want to keep your people safe more than anything. You'll give strangers a chance, but you'll size them up carefully first.
When the people you love are threatened, you change. You can become someone even you don't recognise — and coming back from that is the hardest part.
characters.flaw: When your family's in danger, you stop thinking clearly.
characters.signature: Standing at the gate, deciding who gets in — and who doesn't.
characters.clashReason: they'll do anything for their own people — even if it costs you

characters.name: Daryl Dixon
characters.title: The Quiet Loyalist
characters.summary: You don't say much. You don't need to — you just show up and get it done.
description: Like Daryl, you'd rather be out on your own than stuck in a crowd. He arrived as Merle Dixon's rough younger brother and became one of the most loyal people in the whole group.
You're practical and self-reliant. Give you a crossbow, a motorbike and the open road and you're happy. You're not great with speeches or feelings.
But once you've decided someone's family, that's it. You'll go looking for them when everyone else has given up.
characters.flaw: You keep everyone at arm's length, even the people who'd die for you.
characters.signature: Riding off alone on a motorbike to find someone everyone else gave up on.
characters.clashReason: they barely say a word, and you never know where you stand

characters.name: Michonne
characters.title: The Guarded Warrior
characters.summary: You take a long time to trust people — but once you do, you're the fiercest friend they'll ever have.
description: Like Michonne, you've learned to protect yourself. When she first appeared, she was walking alone with a katana and two chained walkers she'd turned into pack animals.
You're calm, dry and hard to read. People think you're cold until they get to know you — then they discover a warm sense of humour and a huge heart.
You've lost a lot, and you don't talk about it much. But you know what matters: the people you choose, and the life you build with them.
characters.flaw: You hide your pain so well that people forget you're hurting.
characters.signature: A katana on your back and a very dry comment when everyone else is panicking.
characters.clashReason: they won't trust you, and they won't pretend to

characters.name: Carol Peletier
characters.title: The Underestimated One
characters.summary: People see someone harmless. That's their mistake.
description: Like Carol, you've grown into someone nobody saw coming. She started out quiet and frightened, married to an abusive husband — and became one of the toughest survivors in the group.
You're a caretaker at heart. You'll bake for everyone and make sure the kids are fed. But you're also the one who makes the hard decisions nobody else can face.
You let people underestimate you, because it's useful. When she was trapped in a new community, she played the harmless housewife handing out cookies while quietly watching everyone.
strengths: Does what has to be done
characters.flaw: You carry the hard choices alone, and they weigh on you.
characters.signature: A tray of fresh cookies — and a plan nobody knows about.
characters.clashReason: they'll smile, bake you cookies — and quietly outplay you

characters.name: Glenn Rhee
characters.title: The Good Heart
characters.summary: You're quick, clever and kind — the person who runs towards trouble to help someone else.
description: Like Glenn, you're resourceful and brave in a quiet way. He was delivering pizzas in Atlanta when the world ended, and he knew the city's streets and shortcuts better than anyone.
He was the one who got Rick out of a tank in the middle of a herd, on the day they'd only just met. That's you: helping first and thinking about the risk later.
You keep your humanity when others lose theirs. You believe people can be good, and you'd rather keep that belief than give it up to stay safe.
characters.flaw: You trust people who haven't earned it yet.
characters.signature: Squeezing through a gap nobody else could fit through to get someone out.
characters.clashReason: they trust everyone, and you think it'll get them hurt

characters.name: Maggie Greene
characters.title: The Steady Leader
characters.summary: You're tough, direct and you build things that last — including the people around you.
description: Like Maggie, you grew up with your feet on the ground. She was a farmer's daughter on the Greene family farm before becoming a leader who built a whole community at the Hilltop.
You say what you mean and you don't play games. People respect you because you're fair — and because they know better than to cross you.
You don't forgive easily. When someone hurts the people you love, you don't forget it — and you'll make sure there are consequences.
characters.flaw: You hold on to a grudge for years.
characters.signature: Planting a field that will feed a whole community next year.
characters.clashReason: they don't forgive, and they don't forget

characters.name: Negan
characters.title: The Showman
characters.summary: You're loud, charming, funny — and you make it very clear who's in charge.
description: Like Negan, you've got presence. Before the world ended he was a high-school gym teacher; afterwards he led the Saviors with a baseball bat wrapped in barbed wire, which he named Lucille.
You love an audience, you love a joke, and you believe everyone does better with rules — as long as they're your rules.
You're not all bad. You have a code, and over time you can change. But your first instinct is always to take control of the room.
characters.flaw: You need to be in control, and you'll scare people to get it.
characters.signature: A swagger, a grin and a speech you've clearly given before.
characters.clashReason: they need to be in charge of every room they walk into

characters.name: Eugene Porter
characters.title: The Big Brain
characters.summary: You're clever, you talk like a textbook — and you're braver than you think you are.
description: Like Eugene, you use your brain to get by. When the group met him, he claimed to be a scientist who knew how to stop the outbreak — and he kept everyone heading to Washington for a long time before admitting it wasn't true.
You'd rather avoid a fight and solve the problem with facts, gadgets or a very long explanation. You notice things other people miss.
You're not a natural hero, and you know it. But when it really counts, you surprise everyone — including yourself.
characters.flaw: When you're scared, you'll say whatever keeps you safe.
characters.signature: A very long explanation, a mullet and a gadget you built from scrap.
characters.clashReason: they'll talk you in circles and still dodge the question

questions.text: A storm knocks your power out for a week. You...

options.text: Check on the neighbours before yourself
Already have supplies. You were ready for this
Barely notice. You don't need much
Rig up something from spare parts so you've got light

questions.text: Someone new wants to join your friend group. You...

options.text: Size them up carefully before letting them in
Welcome them. You'll figure them out later
Keep your distance until they earn it
Make it very clear who's in charge here

questions.text: You're wrong about something and everyone knows it. You...

options.text: Double down. With a lot of long words
Laugh it off. Loudly. Then carry on
Own it straight away
Say nothing. Just fix it

questions.text: A friend calls you at 2am needing help. You...

options.text: Already in the car
Ask one question — where are you? — and hang up
Wake someone to come with you. You don't go in blind
Talk them through it on the phone until they're safe

questions.text: You're the new person in a group that doesn't rate you. You...

options.text: Let them think you're harmless. It's useful
Prove them wrong with results, not words
Talk yourself up until you sound important
Keep to yourself until they figure it out

questions.text: You've got a whole weekend to yourself. You...

options.text: Out on the motorbike, or in the woods, alone
Gardening. Food you grew yourself tastes better
Baking for everyone you know
Video games with friends and a takeaway

questions.text: You're choosing an evening class. You go for...

options.text: Kendo. You love the discipline
Public speaking. You already love a crowd
Something technical nobody else understands
Self-defence. You'd do anything to protect your family
Do whatever it takes. The rules stop mattering
Put yourself between them and the danger. No hesitation
Handle it yourself — and make sure nobody ever tries again
Get everyone organised and ready. Nobody gets caught off guard

questions.text: Someone lets you down after swearing they wouldn't. You...

options.text: Never forget it. They'll pay for it eventually
Forgive them — once. They get one chance
Tell them exactly what happens next time. With a smile
Walk away quietly. You've been let down before

questions.text: You make a big mistake, and other people pay for it. You...

options.text: Admit it, finally, and try to be braver next time
Carry it quietly and keep going
Own it in front of everyone and fix it
Justify it. It was the right call at the time

questions.text: The world has ended and the dead walk. Strangers ask to join your camp, and one of them might have been bitten. You...

options.text: Take them in, but keep the one who might be bitten apart and watched
Turn them away. You can't risk everyone
Welcome them all. You won't leave people out there
They can come in — if they agree to work for you

questions.text: The world has ended. You find a safe place with walls and food, but the people running it are clearly hiding something. You...

options.text: Stick around and quietly find out what
Take your people and leave. It's not worth it
Start planning how to take it over
Stay put. Walls and food are walls and food
